reference_sql:
WITH opening AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025: the MRR in euros at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(m.mrr_eur) AS opening_mrr
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2025-11-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
), lost AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with a churn event: the MRR lost, in euros at the 2025-12-31 rate
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS lost_mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn' AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT o.month_start, COALESCE(l.lost_mrr, 0) / o.opening_mrr AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM opening o
LEFT JOIN lost l ON l.month_start = o.month_start

WITH opening AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025: the MRR in euros at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(m.mrr_eur) AS opening_mrr
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2025-11-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
), lost AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with an event: the MRR lost to churn, in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'churn' THEN -e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit ELSE 0 END) AS lost_mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT o.month_start, COALESCE(l.lost_mrr, 0) / o.opening_mrr AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM opening o
LEFT JOIN lost l ON l.month_start = o.month_start

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(m)
), base AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, SUM(r.mrr_eur) AS mrr
  FROM months m JOIN mrr_monthly r ON r.month = CAST(m.month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY m.month_start
), lost AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS lost_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn' AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month_start, COALESCE(l.lost_eur, 0) / b.mrr AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM months m JOIN base b ON b.month_start = m.month_start LEFT JOIN lost l ON l.month_start = m.month_start
